covered_report_window.plain_language: U.S.-listed companies reporting after the regular U.S. market close on Thursday, October 1, 2026, plus companies reporting before the next U.S. market open on Friday, October 2, 2026.

market_context_summary: U.S. equities were mixed amid volatile global bond yields, with the September U.S. Employment Situation due at 08:30 ET Friday. That macro release can overwhelm company-specific price discovery between Nike's report and the open. Nike traded near $35.91 during the run, up about 1.4% on the day but still roughly 43% lower year to date.

excluded_tickers.reason: Friday timing was not confirmed as before-market-open by an official or sufficiently high-quality source; also failed the preferred U.S.-company/liquidity evidence screen.

methodology.consensus_basis: Arithmetic mean of three independently formed direction scores and reversal-risk values.
methodology.disparity_definition: 0-100 metric equal to 80% of the mean absolute deviation of the three direction scores plus 20% of the mean absolute deviation of the three reversal-risk values, rounded. Lower is tighter agreement.
methodology.learned_lessons_review: Applied the standing one-key-metric and low-bar reversal-risk rules. No new method change was warranted.

ranked_companies.timing: After market close, Thursday, October 1, 2026 (official release approximately 4:15 p.m. ET)
ranked_companies.pass_agreement: Two Lean Down; one Neutral; low numeric disparity
ranked_companies.method_update_note: Standing low-bar reversal-risk rule applied; no new method change.
ranked_companies.one_sentence_thesis: Underlying margin, China, and Direct demand remain vulnerable, but the severe de-rating and already-low bar make the opposite-direction relief risk too high for a clean bearish edge.
ranked_companies.market_expectation_summary: LSEG/Visible Alpha consensus is about $0.43-$0.44 EPS on roughly $11.3 billion revenue, down about 3% year over year; Greater China is expected to fall about 12.6%.
ranked_companies.upside_case_summary: Underlying margin expands, North America/wholesale offsets China and Direct weakness, and management gives credible recovery markers ahead of November Investor Day.
ranked_companies.downside_case_summary: Underlying margin misses the inflection, China/DTC remain weak, and commentary pushes the recovery farther out.
ranked_companies.options_or_positioning_summary: Options priced approximately a 7%-8% move. Downside skew and a roughly 43% year-to-date decline create both fear and sharp relief/squeeze potential.
ranked_companies.analyst_revision_summary: China sales expectations have been materially reduced, recent price-target actions were negative, and one third-party revision tracker showed seven EPS cuts and no increases over 30 days.

excluded_names.reason: Consensus absolute score of 22 is below 30 and reversal risk of 69 is above 40.

research_allocation_view.rationale: No setup cleared both the directional-strength and reversal-risk gates.
research_allocation_view.statement: This is a research prioritization model, not financial advice.

detailed_company_sections.consensus_summary: Passes A and C leaned down on margin-quality and China/DTC evidence; Pass B landed Neutral because the reset valuation, low expectations, and event crowding created substantial relief-rally risk.

pass_outputs.key_metric: Underlying gross-margin change excluding tariff-recovery effects
pass_outputs.summary: The required margin inflection faces soft Direct demand and a difficult clean comparison.

pass_outputs.key_metric: Greater China revenue versus the roughly -12.6% consensus
pass_outputs.summary: China is weak, but a merely less-bad print can clear a deeply reset bar and squeeze the stock.

pass_outputs.key_metric: NIKE Direct/digital trajectory and management's recovery milestones
pass_outputs.summary: DTC weakness and negative revisions outweigh wholesale improvement, though November Investor Day limits near-term guidance clarity.

detailed_company_sections.pass_agreement: Partial directional agreement: two Lean Down calls and one Neutral; the low disparity reflects that all three stayed on the cautious side of zero.
detailed_company_sections.one_sentence_thesis: The fundamental tilt is negative, but the event setup is too de-risked and reversal-prone to support a tradeable bearish consensus.
detailed_company_sections.what_the_market_expects: About $0.43-$0.44 EPS and $11.3 billion revenue, with sales down around 3%, China near $1.3 billion, DTC down roughly 4%, and wholesale down roughly 1%.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_up: Clean underlying margin expansion, better North America wholesale/product momentum, a milder China decline, or credible milestones for the Investor Day reset.
detailed_company_sections.what_could_make_stock_go_down: Failure of underlying margin to turn, continued double-digit China pressure, renewed digital/store weakness, or a slower recovery message from the new CFO.
detailed_company_sections.reversal_risk_assessment: High. The stock entered near a 52-week low after a severe de-rating; consensus already assumes contraction, options show meaningful downside hedging, and even less-bad operating evidence could trigger a relief rally.
detailed_company_sections.reddit_social_consumer_sentiment_read: Retail discussion was visibly bearish but contrarian, with repeated debate about a fall into the $20s versus a low-bar rebound. Treat as noisy positioning evidence, not demand evidence. Consumer fundamentals remain better evidenced by company channel data than social posts.
detailed_company_sections.options_positioning_read: The market priced approximately a 7%-8% move; put skew had steepened, while the large decline into the print raises the probability that a modest fundamental beat produces an outsized opposite-direction reaction.
detailed_company_sections.analyst_estimate_revision_read: Consensus still calls for contraction; S&P Global reports materially reduced China forecasts, and recent target cuts reinforce a cautious bar. That is bearish fundamentally but also lowers the hurdle.
detailed_company_sections.base_case: Results broadly match low expectations; weak China/DTC offsets wholesale and product progress, producing a choppy or modestly negative reaction inside the implied move.
detailed_company_sections.bull_case: Underlying margin and North America beat, China is less bad, and management gives credible recovery markers; the stock rallies sharply on relief.
detailed_company_sections.bear_case: Margin inflection fails and management signals that China/DTC recovery remains distant; the stock falls beyond the implied move.
detailed_company_sections.final_directional_judgment: Neutral / No Edge, with a bearish fundamental tilt but no sufficiently clean reaction edge.
detailed_company_sections.allocation_priority: Not prioritized; it fails both allocation gates.
detailed_company_sections.disparity_effect: Low disparity modestly supports the cautious consensus, but it cannot offset the high reversal risk or the score's proximity to Neutral.
detailed_company_sections.method_update_note: No new method change. The repeated low-bar reversal lesson directly capped bearish conviction.

disclaimer_text: This is research, not financial advice. Earnings reactions are highly uncertain and can be driven by market positioning, guidance, macro conditions, and management commentary rather than reported results alone.
